name: Bash
description: Unix shell and command language used for interacting with the operating system and writing automation scripts, common on Linux and macOS.

name: Batch Script
description: Scripting language used to automate sequences of commands on Windows systems via the command-line interpreter.

name: C
description: Low-level, general-purpose programming language known for its efficiency and close relationship to hardware, widely used in operating systems and embedded software.

name: C++
description: General-purpose programming language extending C with object-oriented and generic programming features, used in performance-critical applications like games and systems software.

name: C/C++
description: Pairing of the C and C++ programming languages, often grouped together due to their shared syntax and use in systems-level and performance-critical software.

name: KornShell (ksh)
description: Unix command-line shell and scripting language that combines features of the Bourne shell and C shell, used for interactive command execution and shell scripting.

name: Objective-C
description: General-purpose, object-oriented programming language that extends C with Smalltalk-style messaging, historically the primary language for macOS and iOS application development.
